name: Ash
gadget: Action, line of sight, ignoring at most one barricade: perform a Destroy action in the targeted space and one orthogonally adjacent space.
2 charges.

name: Sledge
gadget: Cannot be used while leaning.
Action, deployable, ignoring at most one light wall or barricade: Destroy the targeted space, then place Sledge in it. You may then Shoot and/or Destroy in one adjacent space.
3 charges.

name: Thatcher
gadget: Action, throwable: Destroy all Electronics gadgets in the room containing the targeted space.
2 charges.
notes: One orange hit die at range 4–6 is marked Electronics.

name: Thermite
gadget: Action, deployable: Destroy the targeted space and adjacent spaces. Partitions do not block the area of effect.
2 charges.
notes: One yellow hit die at range 4–6 is marked Electronics.

name: Twitch
gadget: Action, drone: after completing a scan, roll a red die. For each hit, Destroy an Electronics gadget in the scanned room.
2 charges.
notes: Short-range yellow and medium-range orange dice are marked Electronics.

name: Montagne
gadget: If Montagne has multiple sources of protection, cancel up to 4 hits from shots targeting him instead of the usual 3.
Action: Montagne has heavy protection rather than light. A leaning operator protected by his shield also receives heavy protection.
Shield refreshes during upkeep.
notes: No Run value on the card. One short-range red die is marked Electronics.

name: Glaz
gadget: Glaz maintains line of sight through Smoke and Gas overlays.
Action, vertical: reveal the targeted Hidden Operator token.

name: Fuze
gadget: Action, deployable ignoring at most one light wall or barricade, or vertical: Destroy all gadgets in the targeted room except Always Visible gadgets. Operators in that room sustain a yellow hit die.
2 charges.
notes: No Run value on the card. One medium-range orange die is marked Electronics.

name: Blitz
gadget: Action, deployable: all operators in the targeted room receive a Stunned marker, except Blitz.
2 charges.

name: IQ
gadget: Action, wave or vertical: Destroy the targeted Electronics gadget.
Reaction: ignore special gadget effects that cost an extra action, whether they affect IQ or another operator in her squad.
2 charges.

name: Smoke
gadget: Action, throwable: place a Gas overlay.
Operators except Smoke in a Gas space immediately sustain a hit. Gas blocks line of sight. Entering or ending an action in Gas also inflicts a hit.
2 charges.
notes: Short-range orange and medium-range yellow dice are marked Electronics.

name: Mute
gadget: Setup: place up to 2 Signal Disruptors on 2 sections of heavy wall.
Attacker Electronics gadgets cannot target, be deployed in, or enter spaces in rooms containing a Signal Disruptor.
notes: Medium range shows an Electronics marker on the weapon line.

name: Castle
gadget: Setup: place up to 2 Armor Panels on 2 doors and/or windows.
Armor Panels replace barricades where applicable and are treated as fortified walls, not gadgets.
notes: One short-range yellow die is marked Electronics.

name: Pulse
gadget: Action, wave or vertical: the targeted operator receives a Located marker.
Action, vertical: perform a Shoot action (short range, light protection) targeting a Located operator.
3 charges.

name: Doc
gadget: Action, line of sight: remove up to 3 hits from the targeted operator (cannot target himself).

Reaction, line of sight: when another operator is eliminated, Doc may revive them before the miniature is boxed, removing hits until they are no longer eliminated. The revived operator receives a Stunned marker.
2 charges.
notes: No Run value on the card.

name: Rook
gadget: Setup: place an Armor Plate token on the profiles of 3 other operators with stamina 5 or less.
An operator must put their Armor Plate back in the box instead of taking a hit.
notes: No Run value on the card.

name: Kapkan
gadget: Reaction: after moving through a door or window, an opposing operator sustains 2 hits. They may spend an extra action to ignore this effect.
2 charges.
notes: Short- and medium-range yellow dice are marked Electronics.

name: Tachanka
gadget: Action, throwable fire overlay: operators in a Fire space immediately sustain an orange hit. Entering or ending an action in Fire also inflicts an orange hit.
3 charges.
notes: No Run value on the card.

name: Jäger
gadget: Reaction: when an opposing operator tosses a Throwable gadget into a room, ignore the gadget and its charge is lost. They may spend an extra action to ignore this effect.
2 charges.

name: Bandit
gadget: Setup: place up to 2 CED-1 in 2 free spaces.
A CED-1 electrifies its space and all adjacent spaces. Fortified walls and Armor Panels do not block the area of effect.

When an opposing operator enters an electrified space, or targets one with a Deployable gadget, they receive a Stunned marker and sustain a hit. Opposing drones cannot be deployed in or enter electrified spaces.
notes: The short-range yellow die is marked Electronics.

name: Ace
gadget: Action, throwable: Destroy in the targeted space.
Action, throwable: place a Rubble standee in the targeted entryway. Rubble is an obstacle; that space is no longer an entryway.
2 charges.
notes: One yellow die at medium and long range is marked Electronics.

name: Iana
gadget: Reaction: Iana never receives a Located marker.
Reaction: Iana ignores special gadget effects that cost an extra action.
Reaction: opposing operators that Shoot at Iana must remove any one die before rolling. They may spend an extra action to ignore this.
3 charges.
notes: One medium-range yellow die is marked Electronics.

name: Zero
gadget: Action, throwable or vertical: place an Argus camera on one side of a heavy-wall section in the targeted space.
When an opposing operator enters a space in a room containing an Argus camera, or ends an action there, they receive Located and sustain a yellow hit.
2 charges.

name: Flores
gadget: Action, drone: after completing the scan, Destroy in the space where the Ratero ended its movement and adjacent spaces. Operators in those spaces sustain an orange hit.
2 charges.
notes: One medium-range yellow die is marked Electronics.

name: Oryx
gadget: Action: while moving, Oryx can pass through partitions along his route by Destroying them at no cost. He also ignores Stunned and can use blue entryway spaces.
Refreshes during upkeep.

name: Melusi
gadget: Setup: place up to 2 Banshees on 2 sections of heavy wall.
Opposing operators must spend 1 extra movement point whenever they enter a space in a room containing one or more Banshees.

name: Aruni
gadget: Reaction: after moving through a door or window into a room containing a Control, Hostage, or Bomb objective, an opposing operator receives Stunned and sustains an orange hit. They may spend an extra action to ignore this.
2 charges.
notes: The medium-range yellow die is marked Electronics.

name: Thunderbird
gadget: Setup: place up to 3 Kóna Stations on 3 sections of heavy wall.
Whenever an operator in a room containing one or more Kóna Stations takes hits, they ignore one hit.
notes: Short- and medium-range yellow dice are marked Electronics.

name: Buck
gadget: Action, line of sight or vertical: place a Holed Ceiling token in the targeted free space.

Holed Ceiling tokens count as entryway spaces. Overwatch tokens may be placed on them, but operators cannot use them to move to or from an upper floor area. They are not gadgets and are indestructible.
3 charges.

name: Blackbeard
gadget: Reaction: Blackbeard ignores 2 hits from shots targeting him.
2 charges.

name: Capitão
gadget: Action, throwable: place a Fire overlay.
Operators in a Fire space immediately sustain an orange hit die. Entering or ending an action in Fire also inflicts an orange hit die.
3 charges.

name: Hibana
gadget: Action, throwable: perform a Destroy action in the targeted space.
2 charges.

name: Frost
gadget: Reaction: after entering a space adjacent to an obstacle, an opposing operator sustains 2 hits. They may spend an extra action to ignore the effect.
2 charges.

name: Valkyrie
gadget: Setup: place at most one Black Eye camera on a section of heavy wall.
Action, throwable: place a Black Eye camera on a section of heavy wall in the targeted space.
All opposing operators in that room receive a Located marker. Black Eye cameras behave like standard cameras.

name: Caveira
gadget: Whenever Caveira eliminates an opposing operator, all remaining opposing operators receive a Located marker.
Action: from your upper floor area, perform a Shoot action (short range, light protection) targeting a Located operator in the opposing upper floor area.

name: Echo
gadget: Action, drone: after completing a scan, all opposing Located operators in the scanned room receive a Stunned marker.
2 charges.

name: Jackal
gadget: Opposing operators moving to or from their upper floor area receive a Located marker.
Action: from a stair room or your upper floor area, perform a Shoot action (short range, light protection) targeting a Located operator in the opposing upper floor area.
3 charges.

name: Ying
gadget: Action, deployable ignoring at most one light wall or barricade, or vertical: all operators in the targeted room receive a Stunned marker, except Ying.
2 charges.

name: Zofia
gadget: Action, line of sight, ignoring at most one barricade: the targeted operator receives a Stunned marker and sustains an orange hit die.
2 charges.

name: Dokkaebi
gadget: Action, wave: the targeted operator receives a Located marker.
Action, vertical: remove Located markers from all operators in your squad in the room containing the targeted space.
2 charges.

name: Mira
gadget: Setup: cover up to one section of light or fortified wall with a matching Holed Wall token.
Action: if Mira is in a space with a light or fortified wall, cover it with a matching Holed Wall token, then perform a Shoot action through the holed wall.

name: Lesion
gadget: Reaction: an opposing operator entering a gray entryway space receives a Located marker and sustains a hit. They may spend an extra action to ignore this effect.
3 charges.

name: Ela
gadget: Reaction: an opposing operator crossing a room perimeter or entering an entryway space from their upper floor area receives a Stunned marker. They may spend an extra action to ignore this effect.
3 charges.

name: Vigil
gadget: Vigil never receives a Located marker.
If Vigil is targeted by a shot, the shooter must remove any one die before rolling their hit dice.

name: Lion
gadget: Action, drone: an EE-ONE-D can spend up to 10 movement points. After the scan, place an EE-ONE-D token in the space where it ended its movement.
Opposing operators that enter a space in a room containing an EE-ONE-D token, or end an action in one, receive a Located marker.

name: Finka
gadget: Action, vertical: remove up to 3 hits from the targeted operator.

Reaction, wave: when another operator is eliminated, Finka may immediately revive them before their miniature is put back in the box. Remove hits until they are no longer eliminated. The revived operator receives a Stunned marker.

name: Maverick
gadget: Action: if Maverick is in a space with a light or fortified wall, cover it with a matching Holed Wall token, then perform a Shoot action through the holed wall.
2 charges.

name: Nomad
gadget: Action, throwable: move an opposing operator from the targeted space to any adjacent free space, keeping orientation and status markers. If they are leaning, return their Leaning standee to the opposing reserve before moving them.
3 charges.

name: Maestro
gadget: Setup: place up to 2 Evil Eye cameras on 2 sections of heavy wall.
Whenever an opposing operator enters a space in a room containing an Evil Eye camera, or ends an action in one, they receive a Located marker and sustain a yellow hit die.

name: Alibi
gadget: Setup: place Alibi's 2 extra decoy Hidden Operator tokens.
If a decoy is revealed, put only that token back in the box. If Alibi's own Hidden Operator token is revealed, put all of her Hidden Operator tokens back in the box.
Action: reveal one decoy and, before putting it back in the box, move it as if it had 4 movement points. Operators in spaces it enters receive a Located marker.

name: Clash
gadget: If Clash has multiple sources of protection, cancel up to 4 hits from shots targeting her instead of the usual 3.
Action, deployable: choose one operator in the room containing the targeted space. That operator receives a Stunned marker and sustains a yellow hit die.
2 charges.
notes: No Run value on the card.

name: Kaid
gadget: Setup: place up to 2 Deployable Shields in 2 free spaces.
Reaction: whenever an opposing operator enters a space adjacent to a deployable shield, or such a shield is destroyed, put it back in the box and place a Fire overlay covering its space.
Operators in a Fire space immediately sustain an orange hit die. Entering or ending an action in Fire also inflicts an orange hit die.

name: Gridlock
gadget: Action, throwable: place a Trax Stinger in the targeted space.
Opposing operators entering a space containing or adjacent to a Trax Stinger sustain a hit and must end their activation immediately, except decoy tokens.
2 charges.
notes: No Run value on the card.

name: Nøkk
gadget: Nøkk never receives a Located marker.

name: Amaru
gadget: Action: when Amaru moves into an entryway space, she may spend 1 movement point to relocate to any other free entryway space on the main floor, unless she is escorting the hostage.
The hook refreshes during upkeep.

name: Kali
gadget: Action, throwable, ignoring at most one light or fortified wall or one barricade: perform a Destroy action on all Always Visible gadgets and all barricades in the room containing the targeted space.
2 charges.
